subject: Scheduling: Dedicated capacity deep-dive (isolation, autoscale, pool sizing)

Subject: Dedicated capacity deep-dive — initial scheduling

Hi Tom / FinWave team,

Thanks again for agreeing to a technical deep-dive on dedicated capacity. The goal for this session is to walk through:

- pool sizing assumptions for your workload (steady vs burst)
- autoscaling triggers and target SLOs
- tenant isolation strategies and network/security boundaries
- runbook for failover / capacity preemption

Attached is a short deck (capacity-deck-v2.pdf) and a preliminary runbook (prelim-runbook.md) to help ground the discussion. Can we pick a 90-minute slot next week where we can include your infra and procurement partners?

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 25 May, 10:00–11:30
- Wed 26 May, 09:00–10:30
- Thu 27 May, 13:00–14:30

If none of those work, tell me what times do and I’ll rebook. Also, if you want a narrower agenda (e.g., focus solely on autoscale logic), say the word and we’ll tighten it to 60 minutes.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference
